name: Commerce Pesapal Payments
description: Off-site Pesapal (East Africa) payment gateway for Drupal Commerce, using Pesapal's OAuth 1.0 (HMAC-SHA1) API v2 with server-side QueryPaymentStatus re-fetch on IPN and return.
project_description:
This module provides a payment plugin for the pesapal payment platform popular in East Africa and beyond

 Features 
 - Configuration of Sandbox and Live Credentials

- Ability to test configurations for API calls before using the module

 Post-Installation 
 Go to the PesaPal Website and create an account. 

 Demo Sandbox API Credentials can be found here 

 You will be provided with a consumer key and a consumer secret that you can use.

 Go to add payment methods under Commerce configurations and Enable Pesapal and thats it.

 It should be available under your payment options.

 Additional Requirements 
 Depends on Drupal Commerce ^2.36 || ^3 and PHP 8.3+
